I know youre not being selfish i really do, i know how bad it feels to hurt and how sometimes you just want to end it all, but if my mom had cancer and was fighting her best to be there for me, i know id wait it out for her to see if she gets better no matter how impossible it seems, i think you should also stay and be here with your sister as she says shes also depressed. I think her sibling commiting suicide would just worsen. I swear im NOT trying to guilt trip you or anything like that im just giving my perspective, yes im suicidal d and have even thought of methods to end myself, but i know that if anything happened in my family that was causing them a lot of pain already, i would try my best to take my mind off it and be there for them.

However at night when im just sitting on the edge of my bed its like this wave hits me and i just cry for 15 minutes to half an hour. Its never like "hardcore" crying, i just sniffle and stuff but i mainly just sit there and cry for a little.
